description: This file defines extension methods for configuring CosmosDB options in a testing context within the Orleans framework. It provides methods to set default configurations for clustering, grain storage, and reminders, utilizing either AAD authentication or account keys, and includes a helper method to create a CosmosClient with custom HttpClient settings.

classes.name: CosmosOptionsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure CosmosDB options for testing purposes within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults
methods.description: Configures default test settings for CosmosClusteringOptions, CosmosGrainStorageOptions, and CosmosReminderTableOptions, choosing between AAD authentication and account key based on configuration.

methods.name: GetCosmosClientUsingAccountKey
methods.description: Creates a factory function that returns a ValueTask of CosmosClient, configured with custom HttpClient settings and connection mode, using account key authentication.
